title: Autograd Matrix Products and Chain Gradients
prompt:
Implement `MatMul`, a custom `torch.autograd.Function`, and its `matmul(a, b)` wrapper. Forward must agree with `torch.matmul` for rectangular matrices and broadcast batches; backward must return gradients reduced to the original broadcasted input shapes while preserving dtype and device.

`chain_forward(matrices)` returns the product of a non-empty compatible sequence. `chain_backward(matrices, grad_output)` returns one gradient per matrix for the scalar objective `sum(chain_forward(matrices) * grad_output)`. Support a one-matrix chain and do not mutate caller inputs. Prefer a product-scan style implementation once correctness is established.

example.reasoning: The inner dimensions contract and the outer dimensions remain.
